summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release on New Residential Construction statistics for August 2022 (released September 20, 2022). Relevant to the task: It provides the initial Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) figures for the start of the task's specified period (August 2022). The document reports Housing Starts at 1,575,000, a 12.2% month-over-month increase from the revised July estimate, indicating August 2022 did not meet the ">8% drop" threshold for an 'economic shock' month. It also supplies the Building Permits SAAR for August 2022 (1,517,000). While this release establishes the baseline data for the August 2022 entry, it is noted as preliminary; subsequent reports covering later dates may revise these values per the task's "most recent report shall prevail" instruction. The document lacks September 2022 data, so it cannot supply the permit change for the month following August in the event August had been a shock.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD statistical release on new residential construction for September 2022 (released October 19, 2022). This document contributes data for the August–September 2022 portion of the task's specified period (2022/08 to 2025/05). It provides seasonally adjusted annual rate (SAAR) figures for total U.S. Housing Starts and Building Permits, including revised August and preliminary September 2022 estimates. Specifically, it documents an 8.1% month-over-month decline in Housing Starts from the revised August 2022 rate (1,566,000) to September 2022 (1,439,000), identifying September 2022 as an 'economic shock' month exceeding the 8% drop threshold. It supplies the corresponding September 2022 Building Permits SAAR (1,564,000, +1.4% MoM). While this report validates the shock criteria for September, it does not contain the October 2022 permit data required to calculate the permit change for the month immediately following this specific shock. The revised August figures align with the task's instruction to use the most recent reports for conflicting data.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD statistical release on new residential construction for October 2022 (released November 17, 2022). This document provides revised Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) data for total U.S. housing starts and building permits for August, September, and October 2022, adhering to the task's "latest report prevails" instruction. It shows housing starts revised to 1,508,000 (August) and 1,488,000 (September), a -1.3% month-over-month change, and 1,425,000 (October), a -4.2% change from September; neither exceeds the >8% 'economic shock' threshold. It also supplies building permits SAAR for these months (1,542,000; 1,564,000; 1,526,000), enabling calculation of permit changes for the periods in question (-2.4% from September to October). However, it does not cover November 2022 or any data beyond October 2022, limiting its ability to identify shocks or calculate post-shock permit changes for the remainder of the 2022/08 to 2025/05 window.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly statistical release for November 2022, issued December 20, 2022. It provides Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) data for total U.S. housing starts and building permits for September, October, and November 2022, prior to the noted survey methodology change for January 2023. The document reports a 0.5% month-over-month decline in housing starts from October to November 2022, confirming November is not an 'economic shock' month (>8% drop). It includes revised historical starts data for September (1,465,000) and October (1,434,000), which supersedes earlier estimates for this period and alters the month-over-month decline calculation between September and October. It supplies the November 2022 building permits SAAR (1,342,000), providing the follow-up metric required if October 2022 were a shock. However, the release does not extend into 2023, so it cannot provide permit data for months immediately following a potential December 2022 shock.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD statistical release on New Residential Construction for December 2022, issued January 19, 2023. This document contributes revised seasonally adjusted annual rate (SAAR) data for total U.S. housing starts and building permits for the period August through December 2022. It provides the corresponding building permits data for December 2022 (1,330,000) needed to assess permit changes immediately following potential shocks in November. As a release with revised November figures (marked 'r'), its values prevail over earlier reports for the 2022 period. The report also notes a survey methodology change for building permits starting in the January 2023 release.

As an earlier release in the collection, its specific data points for the covered months may be superseded by more recent reports per the task instruction that the most recent report shall prevail.
